title: Instruction-Free Dataflow Fabric: Deterministic Multi-Model Inference on a Configurable Spatial Dataflow Fabric for Real-Time Edge Systems
description:
Research record for a fixed hardware skeleton that any CNN within its range can be configured to become, running as a circuit with no instruction processor in the inference loop. A compiler turns each model into configuration, routing, memory and a static schedule, so worst-case latency is known before inference, even when several models share the chip.

Contents: research proposal; Python models of the window-extraction unit (banked single-cycle window fetch, FULL vs SHIFT fetch modes), multi-model composability (time-shared NPU vs statically partitioned fabric), a skeleton fit map of 11 reference CNNs, a three-model tiny skeleton sized for a ZU19EG FPGA, and an INT8 / FP4 precision comparison; dated design notes and a runbook of every run.
